gate_criteria.description: No production service depends on V4 SQLite. Required history/backups and supported-client/provider compatibility remain available under policy
verified_points: Synthetic test verifies the planned writer-fencing model; no live systemd, cron, Caddy or V4 process was fenced.
Synthetic test specifies read-only SQLite archive/checksum rules; the live SQLite WAL remains active.
Rehearsal exercises a PostgreSQL-only cold-start recovery path; live production has NOT switched to PostgreSQL.
Rehearsal exercises the startup rejection guard for a revived old writer; no real Oracle reboot/fencing acceptance performed.
Rehearsal tests prohibit legacy write routing and split-brain; actual production routing remains V4 by design.
